name: 312. BytePlus Seedream per-image refusals reach the client as content_filter (seedream content filter) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6605 regression, contract C5, C6. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. The byteplus provider there points at /pp/byteplus, where the fixture answers /api/v3/images/generations with Ark's 200 shape: data[] mixing delivered images with per-image error objects (OutputImageSensitiveContentDetected), selected by model. A refused image is counted in content_filter, every image refused is still a 200 with data [], and a 200 with neither images nor refusals is 502 provider_empty_result. 312.4 and 312.5 pin the same on /v1/images/edits (multipart, with a reference image), and 312.4 also pins the resolution tier reaching Ark as size. 312.1 and 312.4 read the bytes that reached the fixture from /__wire. 312.6 to 312.9 pin the other C6 path: Ark refusing over HTTP (400, InputTextSensitiveContentDetected) on generation and edit, streamed and not, must keep Ark's status and code and carry extra_fields.error_type caller_content_filtered; 312.10 is the control, an Ark 400 InvalidParameter that must not be classed as a content filter. Run the whole folder in order.

exec: pm.test('the client gets Ark\'s 400 as JSON, not a stream', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(400); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '', pm.response.text()).to.include('application/json'); });

pm.test('error.code is Ark\'s InvalidParameter', function () { pm.expect(body.error, pm.response.text()).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.error.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal('InvalidParameter'); });

pm.test('a parameter error is not classed as a content filter', function () { var et = (body.extra_fields || {}).error_type; pm.expect(et, pm.response.text()).to.not.equal('caller_content_filtered'); });
